description: Selected reported VIPeR rank-one results, not a complete state-of-the-art history or a controlled re-evaluation.
caveat: Representations, training, parameter selection, and randomized evaluation procedures differ between papers. Approximate values are labeled explicitly.

results.protocol: An even identity train/test split; randomized assignment of paired images to gallery/probe, averaging both directions. The text states around 12 percent.

results.source_location: Section 4, VIPeR experiment, PDF page 6; Figure 4
results.protocol: Average over 10 random sets of 316 pedestrians. Feature weights selected using the first 100 VIPeR pairs. The text states around 20 percent.
Random 316-identity training and test sets, averaged over 100 runs. The chart uses the average, not the best-run 22 percent result.
Random half-identity train/test splits, averaged over 10 trials. Standalone LOMO + XQDA, excluding the separate LADF fusion result.

results.variant: GOGFusion + XQDA, with patch weights and color-space fusion
results.protocol: Random half-identity train/test splits, averaged over 10 splits. Reported result includes GOG color-space fusion and XQDA metric learning.
